# OlbosTrade GitHub Copilot instructions
Read and follow `AGENTS.md` and `docs/MASTER_UPGRADE_PLAN.md` at the start of each task. `docs/MASTER_ARCHITECTURE.md` governs architecture and trading safety, with `docs/trade-desk-2.0/MASTER_SPEC.md` for workflows. Match changes to a milestone ID, verify current code and tests, use focused branches/PRs, keep execution permissions independent from Beginner/Intermediate/Pro preferences, and provide the handoff required in `AGENTS.md`. Never treat a green merge as proof of production deployment. No live orders, automated 0DTE activation, risk relaxation, or deployment without explicit authorization and safeguards.
